title: Supporting Industrial Test-Failure Analysis with LLM-Based Systems: An Experience Report
abstract: arXiv:2609.21843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines tool-augmented Large Language Model (LLM) systems for supporting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of nightly test failures at Westermo Network Technologies AB. Nightly test executions produce heterogeneous test data and logs that practitioners currently inspect manually across multiple sources. We implemented an RCA workflow in single-agent and orchestrated multi-agent configurations, both with access to test metadata and logs. An exploratory industrial case study used two real failure scenarios. Six practitioners evaluated the scenario reports through a survey and focus group, and operational measurements were collected from 120 repeated executions. The evaluation covered practitioner-perceived correctness, reasoning quality, fix realism, clarity, usefulness, and trust, as well as cost, duration, and consistency. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的系统支持工业测试失败分析：一份经验报告
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了工具增强的大语言模型（LLM）系统在支持Westermo Network Technologies AB公司夜间测试失败根因分析（RCA）中的应用。夜间测试执行会产生异构的测试数据和日志，从业者目前需要在多个数据源之间手动检查这些信息。我们分别以单智能体和编排式多智能体两种配置实现了RCA工作流，两者均可访问测试元数据和日志。一项探索性工业案例研究采用了两个真实的失败场景。六名从业者通过问卷调查和焦点小组对场景报告进行了评估，同时从120次重复执行中收集了运行时测量数据。评估内容涵盖从业者感知的正确性、推理质量、修复方案的可行性、清晰度、有用性和信任度，以及成本、执行时长和一致性。结果显示，两种配置在这两个场景中均未表现出一致的从业者感知质量优势。
tldr: 本研究在真实工业环境中评估了基于LLM的单智能体与多智能体系统用于夜间测试失败根因分析，发现两种配置在从业者感知质量上均无一致优势，为LLM在工业测试失败分析中的实际应用提供了经验依据。
en_tdlr: This study evaluated single-agent and orchestrated multi-agent LLM-based systems for root cause analysis of nightly test failures in a real industrial setting, finding that neither configuration showed a consistent practitioner-perceived quality advantage, providing practical experience for applying LLMs to industrial test-failure analysis.
